scope.description: Same two-node in-process execution as the previous probe, repeated to obtain a properly admitted comparison: six decided entries, trim to 4, record read_decided_suffix(1) and (4) and replay the actor cursor arithmetic; all events carry run=1.
assumptions: All produced messages are delivered synchronously to their addressed node until none remain.
No ticks are called, so BLE elections do not occur; leadership is obtained with try_become_leader.
Trim(4) is accepted because both nodes have accepted index 6.
excluded: Network faults, snapshots, batching, reconfiguration, multiple subscribers.

basis.prefix: Identical construction to the previous run: build nodes 1 and 2 from ClusterConfig {configuration_id:1, nodes:[1,2]} with MemoryStorage; pump; node1.try_become_leader(); pump to leader Accept; append Value(1..=6) with a full pump after each; node1.trim(Some(4)); pump. Emit CA_EVENT ready/run=1, suffix_shape/run=1 for from=1 and from=4, cursor_replay/run=1 as before.

comparisons.description: From 1 below compacted 4, read_decided_suffix returns 3 elements for 5 indices.
From the compacted boundary, one element per remaining index.
The per-element cursor after the catch-up is 4, so the next push re-delivers entries 5 and 6.

before.description: Two real OmniPaxos instances (pids 1 and 2) in one process, MemoryStorage, batch_size 1, no snapshots; node 1 becomes leader via try_become_leader, six entries are appended and decided, then the leader trims to index 4. The probe records read_decided_suffix(1) and (4) shapes and replays the actor's cursor arithmetic from source over those real outputs.
assumptions: All messages produced by either instance are delivered synchronously to their addressed node until no message remains (reliable, ordered, no loss).
Only local calls append, try_become_leader and trim drive the run; no ticks, so BLE elections do not occur.
Trim(4) is accepted because the leader's minimum accepted index is 6 for both nodes.
excluded: Network faults, reconnect handling, snapshots, batching, reconfiguration and concurrent client calls.

after.description: Same two-node in-process execution as the previous probe, repeated to obtain a properly admitted comparison: six decided entries, trim to 4, record read_decided_suffix(1) and (4) and replay the actor cursor arithmetic; all events carry run=1.
assumptions: All produced messages are delivered synchronously to their addressed node until none remain.
No ticks are called, so BLE elections do not occur; leadership is obtained with try_become_leader.
Trim(4) is accepted because both nodes have accepted index 6.
excluded: Network faults, snapshots, batching, reconfiguration, multiple subscribers.

prefix.before: Build both nodes from ClusterConfig {configuration_id:1, nodes:[1,2]} and default ServerConfig with pid 1/2 and MemoryStorage. Pump until quiescent, call node1.try_become_leader(), pump until leader state is (pid 1, Accept). Append Value(1..=6) with a full pump after each append so every entry is decided on both nodes. Call node1.trim(Some(4)) and pump; node 2 applies the forwarded Trim(4). Emit CA_EVENT ready (leader_is_1_accept, decided, decided_peer, compacted), then suffix_shape events for from=1 and from=4 (from, decided, compacted, len, decided_minus_from, kinds, tokens), then cursor_replay: start cursor at 1, apply push_to_sub's for-each-element next_idx += 1 to read_decided_suffix(cursor), then apply one later push_to_all_subs read from the resulting cursor with start=0, and report catchup_tokens, cursor_after_catchup, next_push_tokens, delivered_values, duplicate_values, duplicates, decided.
prefix.after: Identical construction to the previous run: build nodes 1 and 2 from ClusterConfig {configuration_id:1, nodes:[1,2]} with MemoryStorage; pump; node1.try_become_leader(); pump to leader Accept; append Value(1..=6) with a full pump after each; node1.trim(Some(4)); pump. Emit CA_EVENT ready/run=1, suffix_shape/run=1 for from=1 and from=4, cursor_replay/run=1 as before.

before.description: Requesting from index 1 below compacted 4 returns the compacted marker plus the two remaining entries, so len is 3 while decided_minus_from is 5.
Requesting from the compacted boundary itself returns one element per remaining index (len 2).
The per-element cursor after catch-up is short of decided, so the next push re-delivers entries 5 and 6.

after.description: From 1 below compacted 4, read_decided_suffix returns 3 elements for 5 indices.
From the compacted boundary, one element per remaining index.
The per-element cursor after the catch-up is 4, so the next push re-delivers entries 5 and 6.

revision_reason: Every event now carries run=1 and all comparisons use identity_fields [run] with a readiness admission that also carries run, so prerequisite correlation is unambiguous; the probe logic, inputs and assertions are otherwise unchanged.
